headline: Khaitan & Co advises Dilip Buildcon on Solar Portfolio divestment

detail: Dilip Buildcon Limited has divested 49% equity stake in ten special purpose vehicles, held through DBL Renewable Private Limited, in favour of Alpha Alternatives Fund Advisors LLP. The SPVs undertake the development, design and engineering of an approximately 1,363 MW (AC) grid-connected solar photovoltaic portfolio across 163 locations in Madhya Pradesh. The portfolio carries an estimated total project cost of approximately ₹6,263 crore and an enterprise value of ₹6,829 crore. Khaitan & Co advised Dilip Buildcon on this transaction.
